choices.label: Pull the red sled out into the snow

choices.label: Ride down to the wooden gate

Climb the run and check the bump
Hike back up to the very top

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=42 beats='Priya checks the gate and the bench where the sled stopped; the drag rope carved a curly line hiding only wet leaves; ahead waits the big sugary drift, and near the old oak Zoe and her beagle Barkley are sniffing around'>>

choices.label: Dig into the big soft drift
Hold the warm boot out for Barkley

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Arm-deep in the drift, Priya digs out three pinecones and one frozen mitten that fits nobody they know, and the snow grows heavier and sugariest far down'>>

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=44 beats='Deep where the snow is oldest, her mittened fingers bump something soft and lumpy; Milo kneels close with the spare sock ready and the low sun slides toward the houses while Priya picks slow and careful or fast and brave'>>

choices.label: Plunge both arms in and pull
Scoop slow to the very bottom

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Zoe says the crows have been yelling over something pink; Milo holds out his one warm boot like a very serious clue and Barkley sniffs so hard he blows snow right off the toe'>>

choices.label: Follow that nose, quick quick quick

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=44 beats='Priya walks the run itself: the middle bump where the sled goes whee has a crust hard as a pie top with something lumpy sealed underneath; the red sled trails behind her like a patient red dog'>>

choices.label: Press an ear to the bump crust
Take one slow test ride down

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=24 beats='Ear pressed flat to the crust, Priya hears it: a hollow little knock right under the track where the sled goes thunk, like a pea sealed in a pod'>>

choices.label: Call Milo over to hear it too

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=44 beats='Milo gasps his best detective gasp; the knock is real and close and the crust is hard; the sun throws one long gold stripe across the run and the streetlights hum, almost awake, while Priya picks how to crack the bump open'>>

choices.label: Pop the crust with the red sled
Plant the sled as a flag for tomorrow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=20 beats='Priya parks Milo safe on the bench and takes one slow test ride, eyes wide for any wink of pink, and the sled goes thunk right over the lumpy bump'>>

choices.label: Ride it one more time, slower

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=19 beats='The second ride is glorious and bootless; clouds eat the sun bite by bite and down Maple Street the first streetlight buzzes awake'>>

choices.label: Beat the dark and head for home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='From the launch flat Priya reads the whole white map: the old pine shaking snow off its sleeves, the fence leaning above the pine corner, the side path curling down past the creek bridge, and the blue mailbox standing by the road where the plow truck rumbles'>>

choices.label: Search the old pine corner first
Take the side path down

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='Under the old pine the ground is smooth and bootless; a squirrel scolds from a low bough and drops shell bits squarely on Milo; just past the tree the fence leans hard with one board hanging loose, and the squirrel keeps glancing back at its dark hollow'>>

choices.label: Follow the scolding squirrel
Wiggle the loose fence board

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=24 beats='The hollow is a jumble of treasures: acorn caps, one rusty key, shreds of red ribbon, and far down in the dark a curl of something pink while the squirrel shouts from its branch'>>

choices.label: Reach into the dark hollow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=24 beats='The loose board wiggles free with a squeak; snagged on the rail splinter is one curly pink thread the exact color of the missing boot, and the gap beneath glitters with old treasures'>>

choices.label: Reach into the gap behind the rail

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='The path runs to the little creek bridge and out toward the road; everything wears lumpy white hats, the creek mutters under the ice, the blue mailbox wears its own snowy cap, and the plow truck rumbles awake with Mrs. Bell at the wheel'>>

choices.label: Tiptoe over the slick creek bridge
Wave down the rumbling plow truck

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=20 beats='The bridge planks are slick as ice cubes; Priya holds the rail and Milo holds Priya, one boot and one sock, and from mid-bridge they spot a small pink lump on top of the blue mailbox'>>

choices.label: Scramble down the bank to the mailbox

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=22 beats='The plow rumbles to a stop; Mrs. Bell has not seen a pink boot but knows a serious search party when she sees one, pours cocoa from her thermos, and lifts Milo into the warm cab like a captain'>>

choices.label: Take the warm ride and draw a search map
